tagline: Leading global manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices
hero_kpi_rationale: The record backlog of $3.58 billion reflects sustained structural demand in niche industrial markets, amplified by strategic acquisitions and organic growth, making it a key indicator of future trajectory.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of unfulfilled orders at year-end.
kpis.description: Backlog reached a record level of $3.58 billion at the end of 2025, up 5.2%, supported by acquisitions and global demand.
kpis.signal: Historical high, leading indicator of future revenues

kpis.name: Orders
kpis.explanation: Total value of new orders received during the year.
kpis.description: Orders reached $7.58 billion in 2025, up 11.3%, driven by acquisitions and organic demand.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth, sign of commercial momentum

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue amounted to $7.40 billion in 2025, up 6.6%, driven by acquisitions and organic growth.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 25.8% in 2025, up 20 basis points, due to operational efficiency gains.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses amounted to $382.8 million, or 5.2% of revenue, reflecting continued commitment to new product development.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations minus capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flow reached $1.67 billion in 2025, supporting the acquisition strategy and shareholder returns.
kpis.signal: Strong cash generation enabling acquisitions and buybacks

kpis.name: New Product Sales
kpis.explanation: Portion of sales from recently launched products.
kpis.description: In 2025, approximately 27% of sales came from products launched over the past three years, indicating strong innovation momentum.
kpis.signal: Ongoing innovation aligned with growth markets

kpis.name: Acquisition Spend
kpis.explanation: Amount spent to acquire new businesses.
kpis.description: In 2025, AMETEK spent $933.2 million to acquire Kern Microtechnik and FARO Technologies.
kpis.signal: Active acquisition strategy to strengthen market positions

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 7A, the language is factual without high intensity. The risk is managed through normal operations and geographic diversification, but fluctuations may impact financial results. The score is moderate as hypothetical analysis suggests losses are not material.

risks.title: Integration of Acquired Businesses
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the internal control report, the exclusion of Kern and FARO (8.4% of assets) from the internal control assessment is a point of attention. The language is neutral but the potential impact on integration and controls is significant.

risks.title: Valuation of Intangible Assets
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a 'Critical Audit Matter' by the auditor (Ernst Young LLP), highlighting complexity and subjectivity in judgment. The valuation of intangible assets relies on sensitive assumptions (discount rates, revenue forecasts) subject to economic uncertainty.

risks.title: Effectiveness of Internal Control
risks.score_rationale: Although internal control was deemed effective, the report notes inherent limitations and the exclusion of recent acquisitions. The auditor also conducted a specific audit on this matter. The risk is moderate as the overall opinion is positive, but limitations are acknowledged.

risks.title: Risk of Non-Disclosure of Forward-Looking Information
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the introduction, the company's commitment not to publicly update forward-looking statements unless legally required. The language is factual. The risk is minor as it is a standard clause, but it highlights potential opacity.

risks.title: Impact of Tariffs and Trade Restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in MD&A Item 7 as a recent trend. The U.S. government announced additional tariffs and trade restrictions in 2025. While the impact was not material in 2025, the language indicates future uncertainty. The score is moderate due to the company's ability to adapt its global supply chains.

ai_positioning.summary: AMETEK mentions artificial intelligence in its R&D efforts and development of innovative products, integrated into Design for Six Sigma and Value Analysis/Value Engineering methodologies.
evidence: AMETEK has consistently added to its investment in research, development and engineering, and improved its new product development efforts with the adoption of Design for Six Sigma and Value Analysis/Value Engineering methodologies along with artificial intelligence tools.
